text: How does the College Football Playoff work? 12-team field and rankings. The College Football Playoff is the postseason tournament that decides the national champion of NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision college football. A selection committee ranks teams during the regular season and chooses the teams that play in a single-elimination bracket of 12 teams.. USC, now 7-2, beat then-No. 1 Ohio State and faces No. 4 Indiana on Nov. 14, a game that could decide its College Football Playoff chances. The newest committee rankings were also released in early November.. The committee's ranking is the factor that determines which teams enter the bracket, so each weekly release is watched closely by fans and coaches.
